docs.title: Project Overview & Getting Started
docs.summary: Main architectural principles and onboarding steps for the Enterprise Portal.
docs.content: Welcome to the Next.js Enterprise Portal documentation. This project powers unified workspace navigation, role-based resource access, and micro-frontend aggregation. Built on Next.js 16 App Router, it uses React Server Components by default for optimal performance.

docs.title: Local Environment Setup
docs.summary: Step-by-step instructions to configure local tools, node versions, and prerequisites.
docs.content: Ensure Node.js 20 LTS or higher is installed. Clone the repository and execute `npm install`. Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and configure your local credentials before launching `npm run dev`.

docs.title: PostgreSQL & Prisma Configuration
docs.summary: Database connection pooling, migrations, and seeding scripts for local dev.
docs.content: The application connects to a high-availability PostgreSQL cluster via PgBouncer. Run `npx prisma migrate dev` to apply pending schema migrations. Use `npm run seed` to populate local test fixtures.

docs.title: Advanced Database Migrations & Rollback
docs.summary: Zero-downtime database deployment guide and schema rollback playbooks.
docs.content: All database changes must follow expand-and-contract patterns. Columns must be added as nullable first, populated asynchronously, and deprecated in subsequent releases to ensure backwards compatibility across rolling deployments.

docs.title: API Contracts & GraphQL Gateway
docs.summary: Federated GraphQL schemas and TypeScript type-generation pipelines.
docs.content: All client queries are validated at build time using GraphQL Code Generator. Apollo Federation aggregates product catalog, authentication, and notification microservices into a cohesive schema.
